chunks: He will then send him to death and have him laid in the grave.

key_terms.أَقْبَرَهُ: He buried him / He placed him in the grave
key_terms.أَمَاتَهُ: He caused him to die / He sent him to death

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'thumma amatahu fa-aqbarahu' mean in Quranic commentary?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Muddaththir highlights the divine power over the transition from life to the grave, emphasizing that death is not merely a cessation but a deliberate act of God ('amātahu') followed by the physical placement ('aqbarahu'). This sequence underscores the reality of the intermediate state (Barzakh), where the soul is returned to the earth, serving as a reminder of the inevitable resurrection and accountability.
